name: Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor
author: Mementor AS

sections.description:
Text-to-Speech for WordPress – Add Natural AI Voices in Seconds
Turn your WordPress posts, pages, and products into natural, easy-to-listen audio. Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor turns your written content into clear, human-like audio in just a few seconds.

This plugin helps make any website easier for everyone to use. It helps people who have trouble reading or seeing your site by giving them an option to listen instead. It can also help you follow WCAG 2.1/2.2 and ADA rules for accessibility.

Adding audio to your pages can keep visitors on your site longer. When people stay longer, it can help improve your SEO and show search engines that your content is helpful.

Setup is simple. No API keys, accounts, or coding needed. Just install, turn it on, and it works with posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and more.

You start off with 5,000 free audio credits and no sign-up is needed. Just install the plugin and start turning your posts into audio right away.

Use Text to Speech to make your site inclusive, keep visitors engaged, improve SEO, and give everyone an easier way to enjoy your content.

See It In Action

🔧 Full feature list, screenshots, and pricing

🎥 See the Text to Speech Plugin in Action (Full Walkthrough in 6 Minutes!)

Why Choose Mementor’s Text-to-Speech Plugin?

Fast & Easy Setup

Just install and go. There’s no need for API keys, developer access, or third-party accounts.

Natural AI Voices

Powered by ElevenLabs, your content is read aloud in high-quality, human-like voices that sound authentic—not robotic.

Accessibility Built-In

Make your site more inclusive with text-to-speech that helps meet legal and ethical accessibility standards like WCAG 2.1/2.2 and the ADA.

Works With Any Theme or Builder

Seamlessly integrates with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Fusion, and all modern WordPress setups. Fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Text to Speech for WordPress: Key Features

Core Features (Free):
* 5 000 FREE trial credits (one-off) – works right after you install it
* Natural AI voices (ElevenLabs) in male & female tones
* WCAG 2.1-AA compliance – ARIA labels, keyboard control, high-contrast support
* 5 languages – English (US, UK, AU, CA) + Norwegian
* Zero-click install – audio player activates on publish
* Mobile-first audio player – speed control (0.5x-2x), download, seek
* Engagement statistics – track plays, completion rates, and listener behavior
* Generator tool – test voices and preview audio before publishing
* My Stats dashboard – monitor your ElevenLabs credit usage
* Content filtering – exclude specific elements using CSS selectors or “no-audio” class
* Automatic regeneration – audio updates when content changes
* Keyboard shortcuts – Space to play/pause, arrows to seek
* Page-builder ready – Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Visual Composer
* Shortcode & block for custom placement
* Lightweight & cache-friendly – no impact on Core Web Vitals

Text-to-Speech PRO (US $3.99 / month, billed annually)

  • 75 000 credits / month – 15× more characters than free trial
  • All 70 languages & 600+ voices
  • 44.1 kHz premium quality audio output
  • WooCommerce product audio – convert product descriptions to speech
  • Voice cloning – use your own ElevenLabs voice ID
  • Bulk generation – select multiple posts/pages and generate audio for all at once
  • Custom pauses – add natural breaks after titles, between paragraphs, and after headings
  • Word replacement – automatically replace words/phrases for better pronunciation
  • SSML support – advanced speech markup for fine control
  • AudioObject Schema – SEO-optimized structured data for better search visibility
  • Media Library integration – manage audio files in WordPress Media Library
  • Advanced content filtering – powerful CSS selector options
  • Custom intro / outro branding
  • White Labeling – hide settings from clients for complete branding
  • Detailed analytics dashboard – deeper insights into listener behavior
  • Priority support – direct access to development team

Accessibility & Compliance

  • Meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA for audio alternatives
  • Screen-reader & keyboard-navigation compatible
  • High-contrast ready; no flashing elements
  • Helps limit exposure to ADA demand letters

Multilingual Support

English (US, UK, AU, CA) + Norwegian

Fully compatible with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and other i18n plugins.

Use Cases

Text to Speech transforms your WordPress content for:

  • Accessibility Compliance – Meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards and ADA requirements
  • Multitasking Readers – Let visitors listen while driving, exercising, or working
  • Educational Content – Support students with dyslexia, ADHD, or visual impairments
  • News & Blogs – Convert articles into podcast-style content for audio consumption
  • E-commerce – Audio product descriptions increase engagement and conversions
  • Documentation – Make technical content, tutorials, and guides more digestible
  • Language Learning – Help non-native speakers with correct pronunciation
  • Long-Form Content – Transform lengthy articles into consumable audio format
  • Mobile Users – Provide hands-free content consumption on the go
  • Senior Citizens – Assist older visitors who prefer listening over reading
  • Content Creators – Repurpose written content into audio for broader reach

Technical Details

  • Performance: Lazy-loaded player with zero impact on page load speed
  • Storage: Local WordPress uploads directory or external storage options
  • File Format: MP3 with optimized bitrate for web delivery
  • Caching: Full compatibility with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, and all major caching plugins
  • Security: Encrypted API key storage, nonce verification on all actions, secure file handling
  • Developer API: Extensive hooks and filters for customization
  • Database: Single custom table (wp_mementor_tts_speeches) for speech metadata
  • PHP Compatibility: PHP 7.2+ with full PHP 8.x support
  • WordPress Compatibility: WordPress 5.6+ tested up to 6.8
  • Multisite: Full multisite network compatibility
  • REST API: Integration-ready endpoints for external applications
  • Ajax: Asynchronous audio generation prevents timeouts
  • Memory Usage: Optimized for shared hosting environments

External services

ElevenLabs API

  • Purpose: Converts your text into high-quality, natural-sounding audio—core to the plugin’s TTS feature.
  • Data sent:
    • Post/page text selected for audio generation
    • Your ElevenLabs API key (if connected)
    • Voice ID & speech settings you choose
  • When sent:
    • Manual “Generate Audio” clicks
    • Automatic generation on publish/update (if enabled)
    • Regeneration after changing voice settings
  • Storage:
    • Audio files saved in /wp-content/uploads/text-to-speech-tts/
    • Files and text also stored in your ElevenLabs account (counts against character quota)
  • Plans & quotas:
    • ElevenLabs free tier: 10 000 characters/month
    • Mementor PRO: 75 000 characters/month—no separate ElevenLabs plan needed
  • Links: Terms • Privacy

  • Purpose: Handles purchase and licensing of the PRO version.
  • Data flow: No data is auto-sent by the plugin. Users are redirected to software.mementor.no (powered by Lemon Squeezy) only when they click “Upgrade / Purchase.” Any checkout data is processed directly by Lemon Squeezy.
  • Links:
    • Mementor Terms of Service
    • Mementor Privacy Policy
    • Lemon Squeezy Buyer Terms
    • Lemon Squeezy Privacy

Privacy

  • No tracking beyond optional engagement analytics
  • Only selected text is sent to ElevenLabs for synthesis
  • API keys are stored encrypted in WP options
  • Full data removal on uninstall

Credits

Natural voice synthesis by ElevenLabs – https://elevenlabs.io

This plugin includes an affiliate link to ElevenLabs. If you choose to purchase through this link, we may earn a small commission, at no extra cost to you. Thank you for supporting our plugin!
sections.installation:
Standard Installation:

  1. In WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search “Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor.”
  2. Click Install Now → Activate.
  3. Enjoy 5 000 one-off trial credits straight away.
  4. (Optional) Connect an ElevenLabs API key for 10 000 free characters every month, or upgrade to PRO for 75 000.
  5. Adjust player style under Settings → Text to Speech if desired.

Quick Start Guide:

After activation, your plugin is ready to use! Here’s how to get the most from it:

  • Automatic Mode: Audio players automatically appear on all new posts/pages
  • Test Voices: Visit Text to Speech → Generator to test different voices before publishing
  • Monitor Usage: Check Text to Speech → My Stats to track your credit usage
  • Customize Player: Go to Text to Speech → Player to adjust appearance, position, and behavior
  • Exclude Content: Use Text to Speech → Content to set rules for what gets converted
  • Track Engagement: Enable statistics in Text to Speech → Settings to see listener analytics
  • Generate in Bulk (PRO): Select multiple posts in Text to Speech → Content and click “Generate Audio”

First Steps:
1. Create or edit a post/page
2. The audio player will appear automatically after publishing
3. Click play to test your AI-powered audio!
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No key is needed for the initial 5 000-credit trial.
After you’ve used those, connect your free ElevenLabs account (10 000 credits/month) or upgrade to PRO for higher limits.

Is the plugin WCAG compliant?

Yes. Output audio, controls, ARIA labelling and keyboard support meet WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

Which languages are free?

English (US, UK, AU, CA) and Norwegian. PRO unlocks the full 70-language catalogue.

Will it work with my theme or page builder?

Absolutely. We test with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Visual Composer and stock Twenty-series themes.

Can I bulk-convert old posts?

Yes – upgrade to PRO and use Tools → Bulk Generate Audio to process back-catalogues in one click.

Does it slow down my site?

The audio player is lazy-loaded and compatible with caching/optimisation plugins. Generation happens off-site.

Can I customise the voice?

Free offers several English & Norwegian voices. PRO adds 600+ voices and personal voice cloning via ElevenLabs.

How do I exclude certain content from audio?

Use the Content settings page to add CSS selectors for elements you want to exclude, or add the “no-audio” class to any element in your content.

Can I see how many people listen to my audio?

Yes! Enable Statistics in settings to track plays, completion rates, and engagement metrics for each audio file.

What happens when I run out of credits?

The plugin continues to work but won’t generate new audio. Existing audio files remain playable. You can upgrade to PRO or connect your own ElevenLabs API key.

Can I use my own voice?

PRO users can use ElevenLabs voice cloning feature by entering their custom Voice ID in the voice settings.

How do I regenerate audio after editing?

Audio automatically regenerates when you update content (if enabled). You can also manually regenerate from the post editor or use bulk regeneration in PRO.

Is the audio SEO-friendly?

Yes! Audio files are properly indexed with metadata and can improve dwell time, which positively impacts SEO.

Can I test voices before publishing?

Yes, use the Generator page to test different voices and languages with sample text before generating audio for your content.

Does the plugin help with SEO?

Yes! PRO users can enable AudioObject Schema markup which helps search engines understand your audio content. This can unlock rich results in Google, improve voice search visibility, and boost overall SEO performance.
